name: Luna DeLuca
source:
The oldest daughter of the DeLuca family. At first glance she appears to be mentally unstable and dangerously psychotic, but there might be more to her than meets the eye.

Unlike Gracie, she participates in family business and knows how to handle herself both in a gunfight and the unarmed combat.
